# MatQuantLab Research Summary

Generated automatically by GitHub Actions.

## What was tested
Critical-materials and commodity/macro shocks were tested against 20-day future returns for ETFs linked to materials, mining, copper, aerospace/defense, industrials, and additive manufacturing.

## Best model
`RandomForest`
